# Kids Care Dental

> Multi-location pediatric dentistry and orthodontics provider serving Northern and Central California with comprehensive dental services for children.

Kids Care Dental operates 15+ locations across Sacramento, Stockton, San Jose, and surrounding areas, offering pediatric dentistry, orthodontics (including Invisalign), oral surgery, and preventative care. The practice uses NexHealth for appointment booking and accepts DentaQuest insurance.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Invisalign
- Braces
- Preventative Care
- Kids Dental Care
- Appointment Booking
- Northern California
- Central California
- Sacramento
- Stockton
- San Jose
- Oral Surgery
- Dental Services
- Multi-Location Practice
